study type: retrospective, nationwide Finnish population-based cohort study
exposure: cesarean breech delivery in the first pregnancy
first pregnancy resulted in cesarean breech delivery at term
Term cesarean breech delivery in the first pregnancy
first pregnancy resulted in a vaginal breech delivery at term
outcome: arterial umbilical cord pH below seven
cohort: Women in Finland with the first two consecutive singleton deliveries of which the first one was a breech delivery
finding: Primary cesarean breech section in the first pregnancy is associated with adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes in the subsequent delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a history of cesarean section with the fetus in breech presentation were more likely to have a planned cesarean section, an emergency cesarean section, or an instrumental vaginal delivery for their second delivery.
